notes: The in-app update now restarts the bot after swapping the apps, so the skill library installed by 1.0.10 actually loads and the Skills tab fills up — no manual restart needed. The Skills tab also re-scans automatically right after an update.
notes_zh: 应用内更新现在会在换装应用后重启机器人，1.0.10 安装的技能库会真正加载、技能页自动填满，无需手动重启。更新完成后技能页还会自动重新扫描。
